step1_analysis.description: A single-transistor Colpitts oscillator subcircuit. In the context of the paper, three of these identical subcircuits are coupled together with a 120-degree phase shift to form a triple-push oscillator, which combines the third harmonic at the output while canceling the fundamental and second harmonics.

paper_reference.title: Triple-Push Oscillator Approach: Theory and Experiments

f_osc.description: Fundamental oscillation frequency of the subcircuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the LC tank resonance: f = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L1 * C_eq)), where C_eq = (C1*C2)/(C1+C2). For L1=1nH and C1=C2=2pF, C_eq=1pF, yielding f_osc ≈ 5.03 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Targeted to match the 4.9 GHz BJT implementation from the paper using standard SKY130 passives.

P_out.description: Output power delivered to a 50-ohm load at the fundamental frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: P_out (dBm) = 10 * log10( (V_pk^2 / (2 * R_load)) / 1mW ). Assuming a voltage swing of ~0.6V peak across a 50-ohm load, P_out ≈ 10 * log10(3.6mW / 1mW) ≈ 5.5 dBm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the bias current and transistor sizing. Expected to be in the low single-digit dBm range, similar to the paper's 1.0 dBm.

P_DC.description: DC power consumption of the oscillator.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly listed, but implied by typical RF oscillator efficiency.

sky130_expected.calculation: P_DC = VDD * I_DC. With VDD=1.8V and an estimated bias current of 5-10mA, P_DC ≈ 9-18mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard power consumption for a single-stage 5GHz LC oscillator in 130nm CMOS.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to verify oscillation startup, measure the fundamental frequency, calculate output power in dBm, and determine DC power consumption.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Triple-Push Oscillator Subcircuit (Colpitts)
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param VDD=1.8
.param L_val=1n
.param C1_val=2p
.param C2_val=2p
.param W_m1=50u
.param L_m1=0.15u

* Supply and Bias
V1 Vcc GND {VDD}
RB1 Vcc N3 8k
RB2 N3 GND 10k

* LC Tank and Transistor (Replaced NPN with SKY130 NMOS)
L1 N0 Vcc {L_val}
C1 N0 N1 {C1_val}
C2 N1 GND {C2_val}
M1 N0 N3 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_m1} l={L_m1}

* Emitter/Source Degeneration and Bypass
RE N1 GND 200
CB N3 GND 10p

* Output Coupling and Load
C3 N0 N4 1p
R4 N4 RF_Output 50
Rload RF_Output GND 50

* Initial condition to kickstart oscillation
.ic v(N0)=0

.control
* Transient analysis for oscillation
tran 5p 20n

* Measure Oscillation Frequency (f_osc)
meas tran t_period trig v(RF_Output) val=0 rise=10 targ v(RF_Output) val=0 rise=11
let f_osc = 1 / t_period
print f_osc

* Measure Output Power (P_out in dBm)
meas tran v_max max v(RF_Output) from=10n to=20n
meas tran v_min min v(RF_Output) from=10n to=20n
let v_pk = (v_max - v_min) / 2
let p_out_w = (v_pk * v_pk) / (2 * 50)
let p_out_dbm = 10 * log10(p_out_w / 1e-3)
print p_out_dbm

* Measure DC Power Consumption (P_DC)
op
let p_dc = -i(V1) * {VDD}
print p_dc

quit
.endc
.end
